profile.summary: A third-party administrator that helps organizations manage their self-insured property and casualty claims, including workers' compensation, liability and property coverage. It was incorporated in Danville, Illinois in 1978 and operates offices across the United States.

review.notes: The legal name Cannon Cochran Management Services, Inc., the Danville, IL origin and the third-party administration of self-insured liability and property claims all match the agenda item and the cited CCMSI pages. The toll-free phone and the 1978 incorporation, 32-office and nationwide-presence claims are also confirmed. The headquarters value rests on the page saying it was incorporated in Danville, which is consistent with the agenda location.
